notes: Intrinsics tuned so the bridge's ROS2CameraInfoHelper publishes K ~ [605, 0, 424, 0, 605, 240, 0, 0, 1] at 848x480 (D435 datasheet HFOV 87 deg, VFOV 58 deg). Distortion is all-zero because rs2::align rectifies the aligned color stream. Phase 5 may sweep to match a per-unit EEPROM calibration. clipping_range_m's far value is a deliberate divergence from the real D435 datasheet (~10m effective depth range): rgb and depth share one Camera prim/render product in Isaac, so one clippingRange value bounds both — a real D435's RGB stream has no such distance limit (only depth is IR-range-limited), so the far clip is set well past the depth sensor's realistic range purely so the RGB image doesn't render black past 10m. If per-unit depth-range fidelity matters later (Phase 5+), split into two Camera prims instead of shrinking this back down.
